value.title: All Stocked
value.description: Every character wanting the item's stock group must already hold at least the stock threshold where the value is `all-stocked`, and one character must fall short where the value is `not-all-stocked`.

value.title: Bind-on-Pickup Tradeable
value.description: An item's bind-on-pickup tradeable flag must be true where the value is `bop-tradeable` and false where the value is `not-bop-tradeable`.

value.title: Bound
value.description: An item's bound flag must be true where the value is `bound` and false where the value is `not-bound`.

value.title: Can Companion Equip
value.description: An item's trait number must fall in the range 34 through 60 where the value is `can-companion-equip`, and outside that range where the value is `cannot-companion-equip`.

value.title: Can Give Max Rewards
value.description: A container fails where one character already knows every script and another character does not, so only containers still worth opening for every character match.

value.title: Can Inspire
value.description: At least one character must sit below the crafting rank cap for the crafting type the item implies where the value is `can-inspire`, and no character may where the value is `cannot-inspire`.

value.title: Can Level Morphs
value.description: A character suits the rule only where the account reports that character can still level a morph, the condition carrying the single mode `can-level`.

value.title: Can List At Guild Trader
value.description: A rule marks the matching item as listable at a guild trader, offered only for the `list` action, and no checker in this checkout tests the value.

value.title: Can Open
value.description: The item must be a container whose cooldown group has expired, and a transmute crystal container fails once the held crystal count reaches the cap.

value.title: Can Research
value.description: At least one character must have the item's trait unresearched for the item's crafting type where the value is `can-research`.

value.title: Can Sell
value.description: An item's merchant sell price must be above zero, so an item worth nothing to a merchant fails, and the test is offered only for sell and fence-sell rules.

value.title: Can Unlock
value.description: The item must be unknown to at least one character where the value is `can-unlock`, which is the negation of every character already knowing the item.

value.title: Crafted
value.description: An item's crafted flag must be true where the value is `crafted` and false where the value is `not-crafted`.

value.title: Target Companion Equipment
value.description: An item's equip type, trait type and quality together must match a signature the target companion build asks for, looked up apart from the character build.

value.title: Target Build Equipment
value.description: An item's equip type, trait type and quality together must match a signature the target character build asks for where the value is `is-target-equip`.

value.title: Item Name Pattern
value.description: An item's name, lowercased, must hold every unnegated token of the pattern and none of the tokens prefixed with `-`, where a quoted run counts as one token.

value.title: Keep Floor
value.description: A currency rule names the amount to leave behind, turning the compiled action into `keep-floor` where the destination is not a character, and no item condition reads the amount.

value.title: Keep Quantity
value.description: A rule names how many of the matching item to hold back from an outbound action such as sell or deconstruct, and no condition checker in this checkout reads the number.

value.title: Known
value.description: Every character on the account must already know the item where the value is `known`, and at least one character must not know the item where the value is `not-known`.

value.title: Level Comparison
value.description: The operator named here replaces the default `<=` when an item's required level is compared against `maxLevel`.

value.title: Location
value.description: An item's inventory location must appear in the list of location ids stated, covering worn, backpack, bank, craft bag, housing storage, house, companion and guild bank.

value.title: Locked
value.description: An item's locked flag must be true where the value is `locked` and false where the value is `not-locked`.

value.title: Market Value Comparison
value.description: The operator named here replaces the default `<=` when an item's estimated market value is compared against `marketValue`.

value.title: Market Value
value.description: An item's estimated market value is compared against the number or named constant stated, under `<=` by default, and this field overrides `maxValue` and `minValue` entirely.

value.title: Max Level
value.description: An item's required level, raised to 50 plus a tenth of the item's champion points where those are above zero, is compared against the number stated, under `<=` by default.

value.title: Max Quality
value.description: An item's quality number is compared against the number stated, under `<=` unless `qualityOp` names another operator.

value.title: Max Value
value.description: An item's estimated market value must be no greater than the number stated, and this field is read only where the rule sets no `marketValue`.

value.title: Merchant Value Comparison
value.description: The operator named here replaces the default `<=` when an item's merchant sell price is compared against `merchantValue`.

value.title: Merchant Value
value.description: An item's merchant sell price, read as zero where absent, is compared against the number or named constant stated, under `<=` by default.

value.title: Min Value
value.description: An item's estimated market value must be no less than the number stated, and this field is read only where the rule sets no `marketValue`.

value.title: Potion Effects Mode
value.description: This modifier chooses whether `potionEffects` asks for every listed effect under `all` or any one listed effect under `any`, defaulting to `any`.

value.title: Potion Effects
value.description: An item's granted potion effect metric ids must cover the list of effect ids stated, under whichever quantifier `potionEffectsMode` names. The value a rule states is a JSON array of effect ids, and stays an array where one effect is named: `["Restore Health"]` states that one, and bare `Restore Health` states nothing this field takes.

value.title: Quality Comparison
value.description: The operator named here replaces the default `<=` when an item's quality is compared against `maxQuality`.

value.title: Quest Relevant
value.description: An item's quest-relevant flag must be true where the value is `quest-relevant` and false where the value is `not-quest-relevant`.

value.title: Reconstructed
value.description: An item's reconstructed flag must be true where the value is `reconstructed` and false where the value is `not-reconstructed`, and the test suits equipment alone.

value.title: Replacement Value Comparison
value.description: The operator named here replaces the default `<=` when an item's replacement cost is compared against `replacementValue`.

value.title: Replacement Value
value.description: An item's replacement cost, read as zero where absent, is compared against the number or named constant stated, under `<=` by default.

value.title: Required Curse State
value.description: A character suits the rule only where that character's curse state is exactly the one named, being either vampire or werewolf.

value.title: Required Skill Lines
value.description: A character suits the rule only where every named skill line is at max rank under mode `all-maxed`, or at least one named line is below max under `any-not-maxed`.

value.title: Set Source Types
value.description: An item's set number is mapped to a set source category, which must appear in the list stated, and an item carrying no set number skips this check.

value.title: Stack Fullness
value.description: An item's stack count must reach the item's maximum stack size where the value is `full`, and fall below that size where the value is `partial`.

value.title: Stock Threshold
value.description: The per-character unit count `allStocked` compares stock against is named here, defaulting to 200 where a rule sets none.

value.title: Stolen
value.description: An item's stolen flag must be true where the value is `stolen` and false where the value is `not-stolen`.

value.title: Target Quantity
value.description: The bank stock summed across the item's whole stock group must fall below the number stated, so an item already banked to target fails.

value.title: Traits
value.description: An item's trait number is turned into a temper trait id, which must appear in the list of trait ids stated.

value.title: Transmuted
value.description: An item's transmuted flag must be true where the value is `transmuted` and false where the value is `not-transmuted`, and the test suits equipment alone.

value.title: Value Comparison
value.description: The operator named here replaces the default `<=` when an item's greatest value figure is compared against `value`.

value.title: Value
value.description: The greatest of an item's estimated value, merchant value and replacement cost is compared against the number or named constant stated, under `<=` by default.
